# function: heading_card

Returns a Lovelace `heading` card, for use in a dashboard `config`. Further card options, e.g. `icon` or `heading_style`, go in `options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  # Same as { type = "heading", heading = "Quick actions" }
  quick_actions_heading = provider::homeassistant::heading_card("Quick actions")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
heading_card(heading string, options dynamic...) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `heading` (String) Heading text.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Dynamic) At most one object of further keys to set on the result, e.g. `{ name = "Kitchen" }`. Keys with a null value are left out. It must not set a key that another argument already sets.
